277563014.description:
Natural Crystal Specimen Geode Cluster
Red and Pink, Druzy Hematoid Quartz Pattern
Geologic Formation, 5 x 5 x 5 Inches
A striking natural red quartz druzy geode specimen featuring a dense field of sparkling micro-crystals. The vibrant red and pink hues are caused by natural iron-oxide inclusions within the quartz, creating a visually compelling piece of hematoid quartz. This specimen has been cut and polished on the matrix side to allow for stable upright display on a shelf, mantle, or desk.
Natural druzy crystal formation with thousands of small, light-refracting points
Rich coloration ranging from deep crimson to soft blush pink
Dark reddish-brown matrix stone with cut flat surfaces for multi-angle display
Substantial specimen with a shipping-ready weight of 4.5 pounds
Condition:
Natural geologic specimen in excellent display condition. The crystal druzy is largely intact with no significant crushed areas or broad losses. The cut matrix surfaces are smooth with minor natural surface pitting and mineral grain lines characteristic of natural stone. No artificial dyes detected; natural mineral coloration.
